prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a small low house in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. dark brown wooden shingle roof walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 176 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the supplied layout-guide image into ONE isolated JRPG pixel-art building sprite. Follow the supplied image geometry exactly, at 1232×896 output representing 176×128 art pixels with each art pixel exactly 7×7 output pixels. Preserve the guide's building silhouette: roof x≈14–1219 y≈196–437, wall x≈14–1219 y≈438–714 and inset lower wall x≈56–1176 y≈715–895; retain the roof/wall division at y≈430. Preserve ALL preexisting door and amber-yellow window rectangle placements and sizes as pictured; do not shift any openings; door should be visibly dark brown, solid, and usable at ground level, windows small-paned with amber glow, not bright lighting spilling outside. Convert all magenta background to fully transparent alpha. Render a small low old hill village farmers' and storytellers' house, broad dark-brown wooden shingle roof shown FROM ABOVE as a rectangular upper block, front-facing wall beneath of horizontally stacked rounded timber logs with strongly legible notched corners. Roof is NOT a triangular front-facing gable. Optional sparse flower boxes below existing windows, minimal rustic details, but don't change outline except chimney may rise into blank top margin. Premium hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG tileset sprite, crisp sharp uniformly sized square art pixels (NO tiny sub-pixel strokes, antialias, gradients, dithering, noise, soft brushes, photographic grain). Deliberate interlocking clusters of 3–10 art pixels, 4–6 earthy shades per material, red-purple saturated shadows and golden warmer highlights. Soft neutral even overcast evening illumination from upper left, bright legible clean base colors, no night filter, no light pools, no cast shadows, no ground, no people, no text. Make sure door is a real door at ground level, never a luminous window.
